main_body: A brown blocky composite shape (a tall central brown mass with a left square block and a tan right-hand lower block), outlined in near-black. It reads as flat brown fills with no distinct horizontal top surface.
top_band: none. A column through the middle of the tall central body (x~20) starts with dark outline at row 0-1, then brown at rows 1-21; only a tiny tan 3px-wide highlight at rows 1 and 9 that is not a band. No lighter multi-row horizontal surface.
evidence: The central column is a continuous mid-brown face from row 1 to row 21 with no lighter top band, no front-edge line and no eave shadow. The left block is likewise a flat brown face with a few tan dashes. The tan right block is a flat fill. Nothing reads as a horizontal surface seen from above, so this is a front elevation with an outline.

style.evidence: The candidate uses about 2-3 tones: one brown and one tan, with a few tan highlight pixels. It has a uniform near-black outline around every shape, large flat fills (the central brown area and the tan block are far larger than 5x5 px) and almost no texture dots. Next to the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps, material-tone outlines and rich texture, it is much thinner and sticker-like.
